This distribution contains adaptations of the following works.

P4 language support for VS Code, Copyright 2026 Zhanghan Wang, Apache-2.0
https://github.com/RabbitWhite1/p4-lang-vscode
db09e8d7a606a1e79365e5c0d04a6bbd389772f2, syntaxes/p4.tmLanguage.json
Modified by P4 Language Tools contributors: extend the grammar to P4_14,
highlight P4 declarations, documentation tags, literal formats, annotations,
members and preprocessor directives, and repair conflicting token rules.

P4 VSCode Extension by Ali Fattaholmanan, Apache-2.0
https://github.com/fattaholmanan/p4-vscode-extension
48428a3bd9cb5508454eb2db2c73838be4076ffd, snippets/table.code-snippets
Modified by P4 Language Tools contributors: strict JSON, dialect prefixes,
match kinds, tab stop order and linked default action.

See the accompanying Apache-2.0.txt for the license of these adaptations.
